workarounds.symptom: External memory providers silently dropped on Agents with claim_instance(..., manager=) (Agent c9de60702c0d)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(memory): pass the Agent's claim arguments through the shared-instance guard (#9060). Target files: api/memory_profile_scope.py, tests/test_issue9060_claim_instance_kwargs.py. Hermes Agent `c9de60702c0d` (on Agent `main`, in the v0.23.2 release candidates) changed the memory-provider claim to `claim_instance(provider, home, *, manager=None)`, and `MemoryManager` now calls it with `manager=self`. (Ref: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9063)

workarounds.symptom: /api/btw writes its duplicate-stream 409 while holding STREAMS_LOCK
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(btw): write duplicate-stream 409 outside STREAMS_LOCK (#9031). Target files: api/routes.py, tests/test_btw_409_lock_scope.py, CHANGELOG.md. `_handle_btw` (POST `/api/btw`) wrote its duplicate-stream 409 from inside `with STREAMS_LOCK`: (Ref: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9051)

workarounds.symptom: Context-length lookup: disabled records still count, api_key_env is never read, three rules unpinned (#8935 review follow-ups; settle before stable carries #8918)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(context-length): a lookup key may also go where a config source holding the same value sends it (#8918). Target files: api/routes.py, tests/test_issue8428_native_custom_provider_read_view.py, tests/test_issue8918_context_lookup_value_owned_key.py. #8917 (shipped in exp-v0.52.655) made the context-length lookup send key K for provider P and URL U only if every host the installed Agent contacts for (P, U) is owned by K's own config source. That closed every cross-source pair v0.52.544 sent. It also dropped pairs v0.5... (Ref: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8935)
